title: origanum vulgare subsp. hirtum
intro: Origanum vulgare subsp. hirtum, commonly known as wild marjoram or oregano, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This herb is prized for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of wild marjoram include acting as an expectorant, carminative, and antispasmodic, while also possessing antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of wild marjoram include volatile oils, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
